notes: Tougher waves: regular foes now gain health faster from wave 6 to wave 30 (bosses are unchanged), so strong builds stop melting every wave before the boss.
New Docs button in Settings (and on How to play) that opens the full player guide: every lantern, foe, world, boon and camp upgrade.
Fixed the Your boons list squashing cards together when you have a lot of boons. It now scrolls.
